North Node and the South Node. Ideas are either
ahead of or behind the times. Misconceptions arise
because of the inability to correctly phrase thoughts.
Mercury Square Part of Fortune: This square shows
that insufficient planning can reduce the advantages
associated with the Part of Fortune. Lack of under-
standing about the affairs influenced by the square
stands in the way of success in these areas.
Mercury Square Ascendant Square Descendant: This
combination of aspects indicates problems in expressing
ideas verbally or in writing, These people are unable to
communicate easily with the public or with close
associates. Marital relations and partnerships may suffer
as a result of breakdowns in communication.
Mercury Square MC Square IC: This combination
points to inadequate communication and poor plan-
ning in relation to fourth and tenth house affairs.
Consequently, the home atmosphere is uncomfortable,
serious family misunderstandings arise, community
standing is jeopardized and career ambitions falter.
Mercury Trines
Mercury trines show those areas that spark intellectual
interest according to the signs involved, the houses
occupied by the planets in aspect and the houses ruled
by these planets. These aspects foster good study
habits and enhance one's learning aptitude. One can
acquire a thorough understanding of the affairs
governed by Mercury and a planet in trine. The
individual is able to converse easily about affairs
influenced by a Mercury trine.
Mercury Trine Mars: This trine produces an astute,
alert mind. These people are quick to comprehend the
subtleties of the situations they encounter. They
display insight and understanding in the conduct of
the affairs influenced by the trine. Their speech is
forceful and competitive. Witty conversationalists,
they have snappy comebacks for almost any comment.
Many develop speaking and writing skills of
professional quality. This aspect denotes good physical
coordination as well as mental agility and most of
these people show interest in physical fitness.
Mercury Trine Jupiter: This aspect indicates scholastic
interest, intelligence, sagacity and wisdom. These
people are often the intellectuals in their circles.
Concerned with truth and justice, many are the
philosophers and teachers of the times. The affairs
ruled by Mercury and Jupiter flourish because of the
sound judgment these people exercise in related
matters. They are broadminded and benevolent, and
seldom make spiteful remarks or derogatory
comments. Unless contrary factors indicate otherwise,
they are optimistic, even-tempered, good-natured
individuals who possess a lively sense of humor.
Mercury Trine Saturn: This trine improves logic and
mental objectivity. Reasoning is structured around
well-organized facts. These people are efficient plan-
ners; all details are accounted for and put into proper
sequence, leaving no loose ends to chance. The affairs
affected by this trine easily fall into place as a result
of sensible judgment, sound management and practical
direction. These people discipline themselves to sustain
deep mental concentration for long periods of time.
What they learn, they learn well. Serious-minded
individuals, they show little interest in frivolous
reading material or idle chatter.
Mercury Trine Uranus: This aspect denotes mental
ingenuity and resourcefulness. Advanced thinkers,
these people are not swayed intellectually by
convention or popular thought. They reach conclu-
sions that are original and often brilliant. In the
treatment of affairs ruled by Mercury and Uranus they
apply innovative methods and are quick to come up
with alternate courses of action as circumstances
change. Intuitive and witty, they express ideas in a
manner designed to whet interest and to gain approval.
They think and speak quickly and are never at a loss
for words. When excited, many speak in a staccato-
like fashion.

Through intelligent assessment of conditions and

Mercury Trine North Node Sextile South Node: These

Mercury Trine MC Sextile IC: These aspects emphasize

Mercury Oppositions
Mercury oppositions produce sharp disagreements. The
individual may not understand the affairs influenced by
a Mercury opposition, or this person may harbor mental
attitudes which give rise to conflict. An inability to fully
develop the affairs governed by Mercury and a planet
in opposition is a result of the individual's failure to
become well informed about these matters. Insufficient
planning and inadequate communications in these areas
are also indicated.
Mercury Opposite Mars: This opposition brings out
mental aggressiveness and contrariness. These people
argue over anything and everything. If they are unable
to win arguments with words they try to outshout
opponents. Disrespectful of ideas that are not their
own, they are harsh, insolent and loud in speech, and
often evoke much hostility. The affairs ruled by
Mercury and Mars reflect the consequences of ill-
considered actions based on snap judgments and
impulsiveness.
Mercury Opposite Jupiter: This aspect generates
exaggerated plans and inflates the expression of ideas.
These people tend to talk good ideas to death. They
overestimate their intellectual abilities and misjudge
the soundness of their plans. Rather than admit to poor
planning, they frequently blame their failures on
others. The affairs governed by Mercury and Jupiter
are adversely affected by the unrealistic decisions they
act on in connection with these matters. Many of these
people are at odds with the religious and philosophical
views held by the majority of their contemporaries.
Mercury Opposite Saturn: This opposition fosters
negative mental attitudes and restricts the spontaneous
flow of ideas. Intellectual responses and nervous
reflexes are slow. These people may be highly
intelligent; however, they express ideas in such a
prosaic manner that others may think them dull. They
have somber, pessimistic mental outlooks and tend to

Mercury Aspects 197
worry too much. They treat the affairs influenced by
the opposition with excessive caution and prudence.
Because they are closed to new ideas and techniques
that might improve these matters, affairs stagnate.
Contemplative, they are not fluent conversationalists
although they are good listeners. Their conversation
is usually of a serious nature.
Mercury Opposite Uranus: This aspect can indicate
genius, but unless Mercury and Uranus are otherwise
well aspected, it promotes inconsistent ideas and
eccentric opinions. Because of their radical views, these
people are often found in the center of controversy.
This opposition creates nervous tension and dislike for
routine. These people institute frequent changes out
of sheer boredom. They display sporadic interest in
the affairs ruled by Mercury and Uranus; attention
alternates between fanatical zeal and indifference.
Unconcerned with the opinions of others, they have
a knack for saying the wrong thing at the wrong time.
Mercury Opposite Neptune: This opposition generates
absent-mindedness, wavering opinions and vague
ideas. These people are elusive; they can be sly,
cunning and conniving. They refuse to be pinned
down to a decision, commitment or promise. Often
it is difficult for them to express their thoughts clearly.
They spend more time day-dreaming about the affairs
influenced by the opposition than they do putting their
plans into action. As a result, these interests are
muddled, chaotic and unproductive. These people can
get too deeply involved with the mystical, so much
so that they lose touch with reality.
Mercury Opposite Pluto: Acute awareness and deep
comprehension of conflicting ideas are produced by
this aspect. These people understand opposing views
and the premises on which these views are based. They
formulate secret plans, which they execute carefully.
Intent about the affairs governed by Mercury and
Pluto, they seldom lose sight of these objectives. They
are powerful speakers. They may antagonize others
with their use of obscene language and overly explicit
gestures. At times their language and gestures may
become especially offensive.
Mercury Opposite North Node Conjunct South Node:
This combination of aspects induces mental laziness.
These people are content with the knowlede they acquire
in the natural course of events and often fail to explore
timely ideas that could promote intellectual growth and
enable them to conquer South Node limitations.
Mercury Opposite Part of Fortune: This opposition
indicates intellectual disinterest in the affairs influenced
by the Part of Fortune. The individual is inclined to
ignore the mental challenges presented by this aspect.
Mercury Opposite Ascendant Conjunct Descendant:
These aspects enable one to establish a good intellec-
tual rapport with the general public and with partners.
Common mental interests provide the basis for
marriage and other close associations. Many of these
people attract younger mates.
Mercury Opposite MC Conjunct IC: This combination
denotes intelligent conversational interchange with
family members. The home reflects one's mental
interests and intellectual tastes; it is well stocked with
books, magazines and educational material.
Mercury Parallels
A planet that forms a parallel with Mercury influences
the mental processes and communicative ability. The
signs that Mercury and a planet in parallel occupy
color one's intellectual expression. The houses that the
two planets occupy and rule give direction to mental
interests and communication.
A Mercury parallel acts to reinforce any zodiacal
aspect that exists between the same two planets. If
Mercury and a planet in parallel do not also form a
zodiacal aspect, the parallel is interpreted as a
corresponding conjunction. A parallel that occurs
between Mercury and a planet that occupies the same
sign as Mercury carries as much weight in the
horoscope as a conjunction. If Mercury and a planet
in parallel are placed in different signs, the parallel is
given less strength than a conjunction.
Mercury forms harmonious parallels with all benefic
planets, the Ascendant and the Midheaven (MO. The
harmony or disharmony exhibited by a Mercury
parallel that is formed with a malefic planet or the
North Node depends upon the nature of the signs
involved. A discordant parallel is formed if Mercury
and the aspected malefic or node occupy different signs
of the same quadruplicity. A parallel between Mercury
and the Part of Fortune indicates mental interest in
the affairs influenced by the Part of Fortune; however,

=== Page 178 ===
198 Compendium of Astrology
the capacity to direct this interest productively depends
upon the strength Mercury exerts in the horoscope.
Mercury Contraparallels
Mercury contraparallels produce misunderstandings
and mental tensions. The individual has little under-
standing of the affairs that are influenced by the signs
and houses ruled and occupied by Mercury and a
planet in contraparallel. Misconceptions and faulty
communications contribute to problems that arise in
areas affected by a Mercury contraparallel. These
affairs fail to develop fully because the individual is
ill-informed about these matters. This person may
have an aversion to learning about related topics.
Mercury contraparallels formed with the Ascendant
and MC are interpreted as afflicted conjunctions.
Except for a Mercury/Venus contraparallel, all other
Mercury contraparallels are interpreted as slightly less
challenging oppositions. Contraparallels that involve
opposite signs of the zodiac bear the same influence
as corresponding oppositions; other Mercury contra-
parallels are accorded less weight than oppositions.
Mercury Contraparallel Venus: This aspect is not
seriously antagonistic though it brings out negative
tendencies of both planets and detracts from the quality
of expression described by the signs they occupy. People
with this aspect talk effusively about affairs governed
by Mercury and Venus. They formulate plans that sound
good in theory but are imprudent in practice. Unless
other factors in the horoscope indicate differently,
communicative skills are inadequate, social aplomb
lacking. Conversational comments are frequently out of
place or ill-timed. These people do not know when to
talk or when to listen.
Minor Mercury Aspects
The minor aspects formed by Mercury provide weak
links between the intellect and the drives associated
with planets in aspect. A minor Mercury aspect
influences intellectual expression and communication
in accordance with the nature of the aspect, the
aspected planet and the signs and houses involved.
These aspects describe mild mental interests,
intellectual disinterest, conversational ease or
discomfort, or nervous agitation, depending upon the
basic significance of the particular aspect formed.
Minor Easy Aspects Formed by Mercury: The minor
easy aspects that Mercury forms indicate mental
agreement and pleasant conversation in connection
with the affairs influenced by these aspects. A minor
easy aspect softens the harshness of Mercury
afflictions; it serves as a partial outlet for nervous
tension and mental stress. The individual is
intellectually at ease with the activities influenced by
the minor easy aspects formed by Mercury. However,
these effects are of lesser importance than the major
aspects of the horoscope.
Minor Hard Aspects Formed by Mercury. A planet
that forms a minor hard aspect with Mercury
represents a source of mental aggravation. With the
semi-square, irritating conversational habits manifest;
these mannerisms are described by the nature of the
aspected planet and the signs and houses involved. The
sesquiquadrate indicates disagreeable mental attitudes,
which are displayed in the affairs affected by the
aspect. A Mercury quincunx implies nervous strain
induced by the planet in aspect and intellectual
disinterest in the affairs influenced by the quincunx.
A Mercury quincunx calls for one to adjust negative
mental attitudes that hinder mental development and
interfere with the progress of interests that are
influenced by Mercury and the planet in aspect.

Venus Aspects
Venus aspects deal with social behavior, com-
panionship, affection, romance and sexual love. They
influence one's intimate relationships; they show the
kind of people one attracts and how one relates to
others on a personal basis. One's aesthetic tastes,
artistic inclinations and material preferences are also
described by these aspects. The signs in which Venus
and a planet in aspect are placed and the houses the
two planets occupy and rule indicate how and in what
areas of life one expresses love, beauty and harmony.
In addition, the stressful aspects indicate difficulties
that interfere with social interaction, partnerships,
marriage, financial development, and one's capacity
to express affection and attract love.
Venus Conjunctions
A planet that forms a conjunction with Venus wields
strong influence on one's social behavior, romantic
inclinations, aesthetic expression and artistic
sensitivity. The sign(s) in which a Venus conjunction
occurs and the houses occupied and ruled by Venus
and the conjuncted planet describe activities one
enjoys, the possessions one desires, the people one
attracts and the attachments one forms. Afflictions to
the conjunction detract from the beauty and harmony
that is associated with Venus.
Venus Conjunct Mars: This conjunction emphasizes
the sexual nature; it unites the receptive and aggressive
sexual drives. These people are acutely aware of their
sexuality. They are passionate and amorous, highly
attractive and attracted to the opposite sex. Sexual
expression depends upon the signs involved and
aspects made to the conjunction. If the conjunction
is afflicted, preoccupation with sex and promiscuity
are possible. If other factors agree and the conjunction
is heavily afflicted, prostitution or procuring may be
indicated. In extreme cases this conjunction may
indicate involvement in violent crimes of sexual assault
or rape. The negative tendencies of an afflicted
conjunction are more pronounced if the conjunction
occurs in Taurus or Scorpio. This conjunction also
promotes extravagant spending of personal monies
and impractical handling of jointly-owned resources.
These people are socially aggressive in the affairs
influenced by the conjunction and in the activities
governed by planets that aspect the conjunction.
Venus Conjunct Jupiter: This aspect is associated with
personal happiness and some good fortune. These
people are gracious, generous and extremely well liked.
They do not exercise much restraint in the area of
entertainment and social pleasures. They donate to
philanthropic and religious causes. Artistic interests
reflect exceptionally fine aesthetic taste. Considerations
of beauty, pleasure and physical comfort underlie
materialistic values. These people like elegant things;
they do not hesitate to spend money to obtain the
possessions they desire. Most are fortunate in love and
lucky in money matters. The affairs ruled by Venus and
Jupiter provide enjoyment as well as ample material
benefits. If the conjunction is afflicted, laziness, moral
weakness and extravagance are indicated.
Venus Conjunct Satunt: Relationships that endure are
characteristic of this conjunction. These people are

Social and friendly involvements must appeal to their

Venus Conjunct Pluto: This aspect generates enormous

sadism, debauchery and sexual orgies.
Venus Conjunct North Node Opposite South Node:
These aspects indicate that the affairs influenced by

Venus Conjunct Part of Fortune: This conjunction

Venus Conjunct Ascendant Opposite Descendant: This

Venus Sextiles
Venus sextiles denote opportunities that are
advantageous socially and financially. Because of
Venus' natural rulership of Taurus and the second
house, a Venus sextile reveals moneymaking avenues.
Activities that offer satisfying aesthetic and artistic
expression are also described by the signs and houses
influenced by Venus and a planet in sextile. Love and
companionship play important roles in the
development of the affairs affected by a Venus sextile.
These aspects are helpful to marital interests.
Venus Sextile Mars: This aspect gives a warm and
affectionate love nature; it promotes a harmonious sex
life and happiness in marriage. These people relate
easily to the opposite sex. They take the initiative in
pursuing romance but are not necessarily aggressive;
this depends upon the signs and other factors involved.
An active social life is indicated. Artistic interests
might include sculpture, woodcarving and physical art
forms created from metal or produced by the use of
metal tools. The affairs ruled by Venus and Mars
prosper under the individual's direction and with the
help of partners or other associates.
Venus Sextile Jupiter: This sextile is a most fortunate
aspect. It is one indication of prosperity. If creative talent
is present in the horoscope, this aspect confirms artistic
ability and contributes to the success and recognition of
the artist. Immensely popular, these people are admired
by their associates, and this admiration is usually well
deserved. They are generous in expressing affection, and
in return receive abundant affection from others. They
may engage in numerous romances; at least, ample
opportunities for romance exist. The affairs governed
by these two planets benefit from the protection and
abundance promised by Jupiter and from the harmony
and balance associated with Venus. Often these people
attract affluent companions and form advantageous
marriages and partnerships.
Venus Sextile Saturn: This sextile strengthens and
steadies the affections; it promotes stable relationships
and a lasting marriage. These people are not outgoing
socially unless strong factors indicate otherwise; they
tend to engage in social activities that are linked to
business or professional interests. Social frivolities hold
little appeal. These people attract persons who are
serious and sincere; they limit personal relationships
to those that are meaningful. They are thrifty but not
stingy, acquisitive but not grasping. The affairs
influenced by the sextile present opportunities that lead
to the accumulation of money or other valuable assets.
If artistic ability is indicated elsewhere in the
horoscope, this aspect enables one to develop this
ability along constructive lines.
Venus Sextile Uranus: This aspect creates a refreshing
social outlook and a lively romantic lite. Many of these
people fall in love at first sight. Love relationships are
not lasting unless other factors in the horoscope
produce stability and endurance; however, Uranian
romances seldom end on a sour note. These people
attract persons who are progressive and stimulating.
They enjoy the companionship of numerous
acquaintances from all walks of life. They benefit
emotionally and financially through social and
fraternal organizations. Friends are a major influence
in the development of the affairs ruled by Venus and
Uranus. These people are quick to realize and utilize
the opportunities that arise in these affairs and their
interests prosper as a result of timely action. Most of
them like contemporary music and modern art.
Venus Sextile Neptune. This sextile is associated with
creative inspiration and artistic expression. These
people derive much enjoyment from music, painting
and other art forms and may possess talent in these
areas. They are compassionate, companionable,
amiable, affectionate and loving. Idealistic and
sensitive in romance, they attract lovers who are gentle
and refined. The affairs governed by Venus and
Neptune provide opportunities for spiritual develop-
ment as well as those directed toward financial

Venus Squares
Planets that form squares with Venus block the
graceful, refined qualities that are natural to Venus and
interfere with romantic and aesthetic expression. Social
interaction in the areas influenced by Venus squares
is difficult. These aspects represent obstacles to
happiness in marriage; they disrupt harmony in
partnerships and generate financial problems.
Venus Square Mars: This square creates strong attraction
between the sexes. These people are passionate and
demanding in love but may be insensitive to the sexual
needs and romantic desires of their partners. Romance,
sexual involvements and marriage are turbulent; intimate
relationships are fraught with arguments. Because of
extravagance or mismanagement of funds, the affairs
ruled by Venus and Mars are largely unprofitable. Social
behavior is often crude; aesthetic taste, undeveloped;
partnerships, difficult.
Venus Square Jupiter: This aspect overemphasizes social
amenities and induces an elaborate display of good
manners and gentility. These people are excessive in their
expression of affection, sometimes becoming flattering
and ingratiating. Both men and women with this aspect
tend to be vain about their looks; they value physical
beauty in themselves and in their companions. Men see
themselves as Adonis-like figures and have delusions
about their popularity. Extravagant and careless with
money, they are concerned with the comforts, luxuries
and pleasures of life. The affairs governed by Venus and
Jupiter usually fail to prosper because of excessive
expenditures and distorted values. If other factors agree,
these people do not like to be alone; however, the
companionship they seek through social interaction,
marriage or partnership lacks depth and meaning.
Venus Square Saturn: This square inhibits social and
romantic expression. These people are shy and
embarrassed by overt displays of affection. They are
not physically demonstrative people, at least not in
public. More impressed with utilitarian values than
with those of aesthetics or sentiment, they tend to view
social interests, marriage and partnerships from a
pragmatic standpoint. Intimate relationships produce
little happiness or pleasure and often lack the sense

Venus Oppositions
Venus oppositions indicate romantic and social
conflicts. The affairs ruled by Venus and a planet in
opposition are mutually antagonistic. These aspects
create rifts in marriage, partnerships and other close
associations in accordance with the planets, signs and
houses involved. They also detract from the harmony
and artistic expression that is associated with Venus.
A Venus opposition may produce financial discrep-
ancies and economic failures in relation to the interests
influenced by the aspect.
Venus Opposite Mars: This aspect arouses forceful
sexual desires. Sexual conquests are more important
than romantic love or feelings of affection, and sex
can become a goal in itself. If Venus, which represents
the receptive side of sexuality, is the stronger of the
two planets by sign position and/or aspects, the
individual may be subject to sexual abuse. If Mars,
which expresses aggressive sexual urges, is more
powerful in the horoscope, the individual may be
obsessed with the desire for sexual gratification.
Despite strong sexual passions, these people do not
relate well to the opposite sex. Intimate relationships
are marred by jealousy. Sexual attraction is often the
primary basis for marriage. Contention and hostility
disrupt the affairs ruled by Venus and Mars. These
people tend to quarrel with friends, spouses and
partners. Extravagance is likely unless other factors
indicate financial prudence. Favorable aspects to Venus
or Mars are helpful in reducing the selfish qualities
of the opposition and in softening the harshness of
sexual expression.
Venus Opposite Jupiter: This opposition fosters
exaggerated social mannerisms and flowery romantic
expression. It also induces vanity, laziness and self-
indulgence. These people adopt extravagant social
affectations. They greet comparative strangers with
effusive familiarity and shower loved ones with flattering
words and sentimental gifts. However, much of this
attention is insincere and their relationships are largely
superficial. Spiritual and material values are in conflict
and frequently distorted. Many of these people are
spendthrifts who live far beyond their means. The affairs
influenced by this opposition lack balance; it is difficult
for one to establish proper priorities in relation to the
interests ruled by Venus and Jupiter.
Venus Opposite Saturn: This aspect places the sociability
and affection of Venus in conflict with the aloofness and
severity of Satum. It is hard for these people to reach
out in love; inhibited and shy with the opposite sex, they
suffer romantic disappointments. Marriage promises
little emotional fulfillment; the marriage partner may
seem cold and uncaring. Many of these people are
extremely antisocial; some develop strong reclusive
tendencies if other factors concur. Economic setbacks
and hardships afflict the affairs governed by Venus and
Satum, causing unhappiness and displeasure. Because
materialistic considerations outweigh sentiment, this
aspect can induce miserliness, greed and avarice.
Venus Opposite Uranus: This opposition denotes
inconsistancy in friendship, romance and marriage.
These people fall in and out of love with alarming
abruptness. They are attracted to exotic types and
persons who can be classed as "different." Few derive
lasting satisfaction from their relationships, and there
is a possibility of marital separation or divorce. Some
of these people marry several times in search of an
exciting partner. Uncooperative and independent, they
do not like to be bound by commitments of any sort.
The desire for companionship is in direct conflict with
the urge for freedom. If other factors in the horoscope
support these findings, this aspect is linked to sexual
abberations and homosexuality. The affairs ruled by
Venus and Uranus are unstable; these interests seldom
develop fully unless both Venus and Uranus are
otherwise well aspected. This opposition also fosters
erratic spending habits and sudden financial reversals.

Venus Parallels
Venus parallels influence artistic inclinations, social
interaction, romance, marriage, partnerships and
financial interests in accordance with the nature of the
planet in parallel and the signs and houses occupied
and ruled by Venus and the aspected planet. Venusian
qualities combine with the energies of a planet in
parallel in a manner similar to that characterized by
a Venus conjunction. The effect of a Venus parallel
is not as powerful as that of a Venus conjunction
except in those instances when Venus and the planet
in parallel occupy the same sign of the zodiac.
If Venus and a planet with which Venus forms a
zodiacal aspect also form a parallel, the parallel
strengthens the zodiacal aspect; this parallel is given
the same meaning as the zodiacal aspect it supports.
A Venus parallel that is not accompanied by a
zodiacal aspect between Venus and the paralleled planet
is interpreted as a modified conjunction when the two
planets occupy different signs of the zodiac. An
unaccompanied parallel that occurs between Venus and
a planet that occupies the same sign as Venus takes on
the full character of a corresponding Venus conjunction.
A Venus parallel that is formed with Mars, Satum or
Pluto assumes the negative characteristics of the
corresponding conjunction if the planet in parallel
occupies a sign that is incompatible with the sign in
which Venus is posited. All other unaccompanied Venus
parallels are naturally harmonious and are interpreted
as favorable conjunctions.

Venus Contraparallels
A Venus contraparallel generates discord, disharmony
and stress in connection with affairs governed by
Venus and the aspected planet. A Venus contraparallel
formed with the Ascendant or MC is treated as an
afflicted conjunction: other Venus contraparallels are
interpreted as mild oppositions. In adapting the
meaning of an opposition to the interpretation of a
corresponding contraparallel, the antagonistic and
separative qualities of the opposition are modified.
Dislike is created by a contraparallel instead of the
animosity produced by an opposition; distaste is
denoted by a contraparallel rather than hostility;
annoying social mannerisms replace socially offensive
practices; disagreements are indicated but not
separations. The negative sexual implications that are
characteristic of some Venus oppositions do not apply
to Venus contraparallels.
Minor Venus Aspects
Minor Venus aspects channel artistic, social and
romantic interests through the energies of the planets
in aspect with Venus according to the signs and houses
involved. The affairs influenced by a minor Venus
aspect create enjoyment or displeasure, depending
upon the nature of the aspect. Minor Venus aspects
bear weak influence on the marriage relationship and
finances.
Minor Easy Aspects Formed by Venus: Minor easy
aspects formed by Venus describe secondary interests
that are enjoyable, and in the case of the semi-sextile,
slightly profitable. They reduce discord and create some
measure of harmony in the affairs and relationships that
are influenced by Venus and the planet in aspect. These
aspects also modify negative sexual tendencies shown
by Venus afflictions by providing weak but constructive
outlets for sexual energies.
Minor Hard Aspects Formed by Venus: The minor
hard aspects that Venus forms detract from artistic
taste, social expression and marital harmony. These
aspects are more annoying than actually troublesome.
They point out irritating social mannerisms or lack
of refinement and suggest little extravagances or
miserly tendencies depending upon the natures of the
planets and signs involved. These are limited to areas
influenced by the aspects.

Mars Aspects
Mars aspects give direction to physical energy and sex
drive. They influence stamina, aggressiveness, temper,
initiative and enthusiasm. Favorable aspects to Mars
produce constructive action in the houses ruled and
occupied by Mars and the aspecting planets. These
aspects enable one to properly utilize strength so that
energy is conserved and vigor is maintained. Difficult
Mars aspects produce dissipation of energy and
destructive action; they bring out the rash,
inconsiderate, angry, harsh and sometimes cruel
qualities of Mars. As natural ruler of the first house
and Aries, Mars influences the personality; as co-ruler
(with Pluto) of the eighth house and Scorpio, it also
has some bearing on joint financial interests, marital
resources, partnership finances, tax concerns and other
eighth house affairs.
Mars Conjunctions
Mars conjunctions induce incentive and generate
activity. Initiative and aggressive action are directed
toward the interests influenced by a Mars conjunction.
A Mars conjunction funnels physical energy into the
affairs described by the signs and houses occupied and
ruled by Mars and the conjuncted planet. The
productivity of endeavors prompted by a Mars
conjunction depends upon the type of aspects made
to the conjunction and the nature of the planets that
aspect the conjunction.
Mars Conjunct Jupiter: This conjunction generates
energy, enthusiasm, ambition and ample sex drive.
These people are physically active, enterprising.
courageous and adventurous. They are go-getters who
expect to succeed, and many do. They make
worthwhile contributions in the areas governed by
Mars and Jupiter. Unless the conjunction is badly
afflicted, the affairs influenced by this aspect develop
fully and prosperously. Adverse aspects to the
conjunction encourage impatience, belligerence,
argumentativeness, recklessness and extreme action.

disciplined; sex drive is partially diverted into work-

Afflictions to the conjunction make it difficult for the
individual to handle Satum-induced frustrations.
Saturn limits the enthusiasm of Mars and restricts
Martian initiative. If the conjunction is afflicted,
suppressed anger can build into resentment that may
be expressed in vindictive acts. Adverse aspects to the
conjunction generate fear of failure, cowardice and
dislike for competitive activities.
Mars Conjunct Uranus: This aspect increases energy,
initiative, courage and daring, but unless the

direction of energies are lacking. This aspect is

extremist, the rebel and the revolutionary. These
people crave freedom and excitement. Unafraid in the
face of danger, many engage in jobs or sports that are
hazardous. If nothing in the horoscope indicates stable
relationships, sporadic sexual impulses can lead to

Mars squares create obstacles that are caused by rash

activity. These squares appear frequently in the

signs and houses ruled and occupied by Mars and a
planet in square represent sources of frustration,
trouble and tension. Favorable aspects to Mars or to
a planet that squares Mars indicate the means with
which to overcome or deal with difficulties produced
by Mars squares.
Mars Square Jupiter: This square produces excesses in
the activities and interests influenced by the signs and
houses ruled and occupied by Mars and Jupiter. It
indicates wastefulness, recklessness, foolhardiness,

Mars Trines
Mars trines permit natural expression and uninter-

and a planet in trine. A Mars trine influences produc-

occupied by Mars and the trined planet. Because Mars
trines give positive direction to aggressive sexual
drives, these aspects counteract negative sexual
connotations found elsewhere in the horoscope.
Mars Trine Jupiter: This trine produces abundant
energy, ambition and enthusiasm and gives positive
direction to actions. It combines motivation, initiative
and action with integrity, wisdom and good fortune,

and Jupiter. Unless strong contradictory factors are
present in the horoscope, these people are high-
principled. honest and forthright. This aspect indicates
physical strength and muscularity; it also increases
sexual vigor and gives positive expression to sexual
drives. The protective qualities of Jupiter act as
safeguards against bodily harm.
Mars Trine Saturn: This aspect is extremely helpful,

Mars Trine Neptune: This trine strengthens spiritual

diverted into spiritual channels.
Mars Trine Pluto: This aspect produces physical

Mars Oppositions
Mars oppositions generate competitiveness, aggres-
siveness and anger. They are associated with verbal
and/or physical confrontations as indicated by the
nature of the opposing planets, the signs involved, and
other factors that bear upon the oppositions. A Mars
opposition gives rise to destructive belligerence,
hostility and strife if neither Mars nor the opposing
planet forms easy or stabilizing aspects with other
planets to restrain the violence that is associated with
Mars oppositions. The individual is quick to rise to
the challenges evoked by a Mars opposition, but action
is impulsive, rash, and often foolhardy, until this
person learns to channel Mars energy productively.
Without constructive direction, energy is misspent in
fruitless activity, pointless arguments or senseless
physical combat. The affairs influenced by the signs
and houses ruled and occupied by Mars and a planet
in opposition produce conflict and antagonism. Mars
oppositions indicate willfulness and foolish daring;
they are associated with risky acts that cause accidents
and endanger physical safety.
Mars Opposite Jupiter: This aspect dissipates energy
through excessive physical activity. These people cannot
pace themselves. They tend to take on more than they
can possibly accomplish and push themselves to the
point of physical exhaustion. Extravagant and reckless,
they misjudge the effectiveness of their actions in the
affairs governed by Mars and Jupiter. This aspect creates
foolhardy daring, many of these people risk physical
safety to prove fearlessness. It encourages gambling
tendencies, and these people may speculate with others'
funds as well as their own. In sexual matters they are
usually the aggressors.
Mars Opposite Saturn: This opposition pits the
impatience, rashness and haste of Mars against the
patience, caution and deliberateness characterized by
Saturn. The individual is torn between the impulse to
act and fear of consequences if the action is carried
out. Resultant frustrations breed resentment and
hostility. This aspect fosters bravado, but courage and
defiance break down when the individual is backed
into a comer. At times, aggressive and decisive action
is taken in the affairs governed by Mars and Saturn;
at other times, inhibitions and fears retard progress.
Sexual drives alternate between intense passion and
frigidity. If other factors in the horoscope confirm, this
aspect can indicate impotence.
Mars Opposite Uranus: This aspect prompts precipitous
actions; it engenders impetuousness, recklessness,
insolence, rebelliousness and radicalism. In the activities
influenced by the opposition these people demand
complete freedom of action. They institute drastic
changes without considering the full implications of their
actions. External circumstances that affect the affairs
ruled by Mars and Uranus cause instability and
turbulence. This aspect is associated with violence,
accidents, riots, death-defying exploits and military
dangers. Sexual expression is erratic and unconventional.
Some of these people engage in promiscuous sexual
relations or bizarre forms of sexual expression if
confirming factors are present in the horoscope.
Mars Opposite Neptune: This aspect weakens physical
energy and reduces muscularity. Unless the Sun is
strong by sign and aspect, vitality and recuperative
powers are undermined. The affairs influenced by this
opposition denote areas of ambiguity, ineptitude,
delusion and gullibility. This aspect can foster fraud
and scandal in the affected areas and these people may
engage in clandestine activities in connection with the
affairs ruled by Mars and Neptune. Conflict between
physical urges and spiritual drives is created by this
opposition. It is associated with sexual beguilement,
seduction, sexual intrigue and drug-related sex cults.
Mars Opposite Pluto: This opposition fosters violence,
brutality, sexual abuse and criminal tendencies.

counteract negative tendencies generated by the

powerful physical drives. This aspect produces
enormous physical strength. These people seem to
attract antagonism and conflict in the affairs governed
by Mars and Pluto and tend to rely on physical force
as the means of dealing with opposition. Some of these
people resort to psychic control to obtain power in

Mars Parallels
Initiative and aggressiveness are activated and energy
is directed into the affairs ruled by the signs and houses
governed and occupied by Mars and the planet(s) that
form parallels with Mars. A parallel that occurs between
Mars and a planet with which Mars also forms a zodiacal
aspect is given the same meaning as that aspect and,
therefore, supplements and strengthens it.
A parallel that is formed by Mars and a planet that
does not aspect Mars zodiacally is interpreted as a mild
conjunction with certain modifications. A parallel that
occurs between Mars and Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus,
Neptune or Pluto is interpreted as an afflicted
conjunction if the two planets in aspect occupy
different signs of the same quadruplicity or if either
planet is heavily afflicted. However, these parallels do
not carry the negative sexual implications associated
with corresponding conjunctions. An unaccompanied
parallel, which Mars forms with the North Node, Part
of Fortune, Ascendant or Midheaven, takes on the
positive attributes of the corresponding conjunction
regardless of the signs or other aspects involved.
Mars Contraparallels
A Mars contraparallel generates conflict in the areas
influenced by the aspect. Discord is evident in the
affairs described by the signs and houses occupied and
ruled by Mars and a planet in contraparallel. Mars
contraparallels indicate areas in which action is
impulsive, headstrong and rash. A contraparallel that
occurs between Mars and the Ascendant or MC acts
as an afflicted conjunction. All other Mars contra-
parallels are interpreted as corresponding oppositions,
omitting negative sexual tendencies if such are shown
by the opposition. Mars contraparallels do not distort
sexual drives.
Minor Mars Aspects
The minor aspects that Mars forms exert mild influence
in accordance with the significance of the aspects and
the natures of the aspecting planets. This influence
manifests in the affairs ruled by Mars and the planets
in aspect.
Minor Easy Aspects Formed by Mars: Minor easy
aspects formed by Mars indicate constructive channels
for Mars action. They point out secondary avenues
for release of frustrations induced by adverse aspects
to Mars.
Minor Hard Aspects Formed by Mars: Minor hard
aspects formed by Mars indicate impatience, aggravation
and anger. Mild agitation is evident in the affairs
governed by Mars and the aspected planets. These
aspects do not encourage violence, sexual aberrations
or other strongly negative Martian tendencies.

Jupiter Aspects
Jupiter aspects describe religious, ethical, moral and
philosophical values. They influence wisdom, judg-
ment, abstract thought and higher education.
Favorable Jupiter aspects give direction to the
expansive and protective properties of this planet;
adverse aspects detract from the beneficial qualities
of Jupiter and often encourage excesses.
The aspects Jupiter forms with Saturn, Uranus,
Neptune and Pluto are interpreted more broadly than
aspects that occur between Jupiter and the personal
planets. Aspects between Jupiter and heavy planets
remain in orb for much longer periods of time than
aspects formed with the faster-moving planets. Heavy
Jupiter aspects can be in effect for several months when
motion is slow of course or retrograde; therefore, the
same aspect can appear in the horoscopes of many
people in the same age group. House placement and
other aspects that influence a common Jupiter aspect
will differ in horoscopes that contain the same heavy
aspect. The houses occupied and ruled by Jupiter and
a heavy planet in aspect and the other aspects these
two planets form show how the heavy Jupiter aspect
affects the individual.
If Jupiter is placed in the first house of a horoscope,
is the chart ruler or disposits the chart ruler, the Sun,
or the Moon, the aspects Jupiter forms with heavy
planets have a more personal connotation,
Jupiter Conjunctions
The influence of a conjunction that occurs between
Jupiter and a heavy planet is felt primarily in the house
in which the conjunction takes place and in the houses
of the horoscope that are ruled by Jupiter and the
conjuncted planet according to the sign on the cusp. This
influence extends to the affairs governed by planets that
aspect the conjunction. The influence of the conjunction
in the natural houses of Jupiter (ninth and twelfth) and
the natural house(s) of the conjuncted planet is general,
for it concerns a large number of horoscopes.
The emphasis of a Jupiter conjunction depends upon
aspects made to the conjunction by other planets. If
the conjunction is favorably aspected, the finer
qualities of Jupiter manifest. If the conjunction is
afflicted, excesses, extravagances and poor judgment
are shown in regard to the affairs described by the
signs and houses occupied and ruled by Jupiter, the
conjuncted planet and the afflicting planet(s).
Jupiter Conjunct Saturn: This aspect occurs about
every twenty years. It restrains potential excesses in
the affairs influenced by Jupiter and Saturn. It fosters
reliability, sincerity, rather narrow ethical standards
and realistic values. If it is well aspected, this conjunc-
tion is a strong indication of success, for it links the
opportunities and prosperity associated with Jupiter
to the diligence and persistence attributed to Saturn.
If the conjunction is afflicted, Saturn imposes severe
limitation on Jupiterian expansiveness and good
fortune. With an applying conjunction, hopeful
opportunities can turn sour as Saturn imposes hard
work, heavy responsibilities and slow progress. A
separating conjunction indicates that hard work and
dedicated effort will be eventually rewarded; the
narrower the orb, the longer it lakes to gain success
and the greater the effort required to attain the benefits
promised by Jupiter.

Jupiter Trine Part of Fortune: This trine is a fortunate
aspect. It promises progress in the areas of horoscope
influence and assures some measure of success and
affluence even if Jupiter and the Part of Fortune are
afflicted. If afflictions exist, this trine enables one to
surmount difficulties. The individual can constructively
utilize conditions associated with the trine whether or
not these circumstances are entirely favorable.
Jupiter Trine Ascendant Sextile Descendant: This
aspect combination brings out positive attributes of
the Ascendant. These people express goodwill and
thereby attract the goodwill of others. These aspects

Jupiter Trine MC Sextile IC: This combination of aspects
generates conditions that are conducive to career and
business success. These people are considered honest and
trustworthy unless Jupiter is heavily afflicted or other
factors in the horoscope detract from their reputations.
Opportunities for advancement frequently stem from
family connections.
Jupiter Oppositions
Jupiter oppositions generate immoderation in the affairs
governed by Jupiter and opposing planets. Positive
planetary expression is distorted by overemphasis or
magnification of the principles represented by a planet
that opposes Jupiter. Jupiter oppositions describe areas
in which legal, philosophical and religious differences
arise. These aspects influence developments that interfere
with higher education,
Jupiter Opposite Saturn: This aspect creates conflict
between the principle of expansion, represented by
Jupiter, and the principle of contraction, characterized
by Saturn. The individual is forced to take a hard view
of conditions generated by the opposition. If the
individual is pessimistically inclined or lacks
determination, a defeatist attitude is apt to develop. If
courage and persistence a re shown in the horoscope, the
individual is better able to maintain a balanced, realistic
perspective. This aspect does not preclude success, but
progress tends to be gradual. Development of affairs
governed by Jupiter and Saturn is restrained by heavy
responsibilities, hardships and extreme conservatism.
Many of these people are strict conformists who are
afraid to break with tradition. This aspect fosters
religious bias and prejudicial attitudes.
Jupiter Opposite Uranus: This opposition forces
awareness of the importance of freedom and magnifies
the need for it in both thought and action. These
people balk at laws and traditions that restrict
individual liberties or impinge upon civil rights. Efforts
toward reform are directed at the affairs influenced
by the houses ruled and occupied by Jupiter and
Uranus. The influence of this aspect depends upon the
overall tenor of the horoscope. In a strong horoscope
that lends to constructive action, progressive changes,
which benefit all of humanity, are indicated. If
common sense and direction are lacking, the individual
may do little more than arouse religious controversy
or incite civil disobedience. This aspect is found in
horoscopes of rabble-rousing radicals as well as in
horoscopes of great humanitarians.
Jupiter Opposite Neptune. This aspect produces
religious and spiritual conflicts. These people are
spiritually idealistic and may blindly follow religious
charlatans. They are inept in conducting the affairs
governed by Jupiter and Neptune unless other factors
in the horoscope provide practical direction in these
matters. This aspect encourages wishful thinking,
illusory ideals and Utopian dreams, which are out of
place in the real world. Favorable aspects to lupiter

Jupiter Opposite Pluto: Religious purges and atrocities

Jupiter Parallels
Jupiter parallels influence one's values and beliefs.
These aspects, if unafflicted, denote good fortune and
success. If Jupiter and a planet in parallel also form
a zodiacal aspect, the parallel assumes the nature of
the zodiacal aspect and thereby strengthens it. A
parallel that occurs between Jupiter and a planet not
in zodiacal aspect with Jupiter is treated as a
moderately forceful conjunction. The effect of an
unaccompanied Jupiter parallel is milder than that of
a corresponding conjunction, although the tenor is the
same. Unaccompanied Jupiter parallels indicate
successful development of affairs that come under the
influence of the planets, signs and houses involved;
associated interests are safeguarded unless afflictions
are present.
Jupiter Contraparallels
Jupiter contraparallels formed with the Ascendant and
MC are interpreted as afflicted conjunctions. Other
Jupiter contraparallels act as weak oppositions.
Contraparallels do not produce the sharp conflict
associated with oppositions. The energies of Jupiter
and a planet in contraparallel are disparate; action is
discordant. Conditions of disharmony manifest in
affairs associated with the signs and houses ruled and
occupied by Jupiter and planets in contraparallel.
With the exception of a contraparallel formed with
Satum, Jupiter contraparallels bring excesses and
extravagances into play. The properties of a planet that
forms a contraparallel with Jupiter are magnified; these
energies lack constructive direction and adequate
restraint. The prolific action of Jupiter produces over-
expansion in the affairs influenced by a contraparallel.
A contraparallel between Jupiter and Satum inhibits
expansion; interests governed by these two planets
develop slowly when under the influence of a contra-
parallel. A Jupiter/Satum contraparallel contributes to
prejudicial beliefs.

Saturn Aspects
Saturn aspects point to areas in the horoscope in which
responsibility and discipline manifest. The energies of
planets that form easy aspects with Saturn can be
channeled constructively into the houses ruled and
occupied by Saturn and the aspecting planets, for
Saturn lends structure to related endeavors. Adverse
Saturn aspects discipline harshly; they generate
frustrating conditions that restrict the free flow of
planetary energies.
Aspects that occur between Saturn and Uranus,
Neptune or Pluto have general influence on many people
because the same aspect appears in numerous
horoscopes. They are interpreted broadly unless one of
the planets forming the aspect of interest is of particular
importance or strength in the individual's horoscope. The
significance of a common Saturn aspect is emphasized
mainly in the houses occupied and ruled by Saturn and
the aspected planet. The influence exerted in the natural
houses of the aspecting planets and in the signs these
planets occupy and rule is secondary: it depends upon
the strength of other aspects of these planets and the
overall tenor of the horoscope.
Satum Conjunctions
A Saturn conjunction forces serious, mature,
responsible action in the affairs governed by Satum
and the planet it conjuncts. If the conjunction is
favorably aspected, discipline takes the form of
practical restraints that foster singleness of purpose,
conservative action and systematic procedures in the
activities influenced by the conjunction. Hard work
and perseverance are rewarded eventually. If the
conjunction is afflicted, discipline is restrictive; rigid
conditions and setbacks generate discouragement and
frequently produce failure.
Satum Conjunct Uranus: This conjunction occurs
about every ninety-one years. This aspect restrains
excessive radicalism and modifies extreme conserva-
tism. Inventiveness is directed toward practical ends.
Prudence and foresight combine to produce
constructive action. These people carefully consider
potential risks before they implement changes in affairs
governed by Satum and Uranus. They are not overly
cautious but they do not take foolish chances either.
If the conjunction is afflicted, development of related
interests is erratic. The tendency to push too far ahead
at times and lag behind at others generates unstable
conditions. The lack of consistent effort hinders
progress in the areas of horoscope activation.
Satum Conjunct Neptune: This aspect forms
approximately every thirty-five years. If unafflicted,
this conjunction gives concrete expression to creative
and artistic abilities. These people differentiate
between the real and unreal and are able to give
practical application to their dreams. The combination
of inspiration and dedicated effort represented by this
aspect fosters remarkable development in the affairs
ruled by Satum and Neptune. If the conjunction is
seriously afflicted, discouragement, anxiety and
apprehension obstruct progress. Some of these people
cannot face the harshness of life; they become
despondent and withdraw from reality.
Satum Conjunct Pluto: This conjunction harnesses
intense Plutonian energy and focuses it into the affairs

governed by Saturn and Pluto. Power and ambition
are directed constructively. Great accomplishments are
possible if neither planet is badly afflicted. If the
conjunction is afflicted, the individual may employ
methods that are harsh, ruthless and cruel in order to
attain ambitions.
Saturn Conjunct North Node Opposite South Node:
These aspects indicate that the individual accepts
traditional values and conservative social trends. If
this person is bom into an unstructured or extremely
avant-garde society, he or she may be a misfit. It is
difficult for this individual to overcome biased
attitudes and to adopt new social concepts.
Saturn Conjunct Part of Fortune: This aspect delays

not deny these rewards unless the conjunction is

disciplined action and constructive endeavor.
Saturn Conjunct Ascendant Opposite Descendant: A

Saturn Sextiles
Saturn sextiles are associated with disciplined,
responsible endeavors. These aspects bring stability
to the activities of the houses and planets involved.
Saturn sextiles show how and in what areas the
individual's organizing ability is best applied. A Saturn
sextile denotes opportunity for development and
steady progress in the affairs influenced by the aspect.
Saturn Sextile Uranus: This aspect combines the urge
for freedom with the need for discipline. These
contrasting qualities do not conflict when Saturn and
Uranus form a sextile; rather, the urge for freedom
is directed constructively into affairs governed by the
two planets. These people respect tradition; however,
they are not bound by conventions. This sextile
produces opportunities that enable one to be
innovative within the framework of traditional
concepts. Old ways are updated and adapted to
modem needs. Changes induced by this aspect are
both practical and timely.
Saturn Sextile Neptune: This sextile brings visionary
powers down to earth. Saturn, the realist, forces
Neptune, the dreamer, to be practical and definitive.
Saturn permits no ambiguities or illusions. This aspect
does, however, shield from public scrutiny the
activities ruled by Saturn and Neptune. These people
exert considerable background influence in affairs
affected by the sextile. Opportunities that permit
constructive, behind-the-scenes action are generated
by this sextile.
Saturn Sextile Pluto: This aspect disciplines the power
of Pluto. It gives opportunities for regeneration that
can be developed by structured, responsible action.
Through hard work and intense effort, the affairs
influenced by this sextile can be transformed and
upgraded. These people frequently attain positions of
authority in areas activated by the sextile, though
many remain anonymous to the public despite the
enormous power they wield.
Saturn Sextile North Node Trine South Node: This
aspect combination shows that the individual respects
the traditions of society. Experiences induced by the
North Node have a maturing effect. This person has
the discipline and restraint required to overcome South
Node limitations.
Saturn Sextile Part of Fortune: Benefits derived from
opportunities generated by this sextile have lasting
impact upon the individual. Substantial advantages
stem from interests that are influenced by Saturn and
the Part of Fortune.
Saturn Sextile Ascendant Trine Descendant: These
aspects contribute to serious attitudes, personal
reserve, reticence and reliability. Unless contradictory
factors appear in the horoscope, a lasting marriage and
stable partnerships are indicated.

Saturn Squares
Saturn squares give rise to severe difficulties. These
aspects teach patience and perseverance but often
produce discouragement and pessimism as well. A
Saturn square forces the individual to deal with major
obstacles and to work diligently in order to
successfully develop affairs governed by Saturn and
the squared planet. The way a person responds to a
Saturn square depends upon personal characteristics
and other factors in the horoscope that affect one's
capacity to handle frustations and misfortunes. One
person may bear Satum-induced burdens in abject
resignation; another may surmount handicaps and rise
to success. Saturn demands disciplined action. This
planet, when squared, punishes sternly if discipline is
lacking; the punishment is failure.
Saturn Square Uranus: This square poses a dilemma.
The individual is at once faced with the need for
discipline and the desire for freedom. Situations arise
which demand circumspect and cautious action; yet,
this person rebels at restraint. Precipitate action creates
severe setbacks in the affairs ruled by Saturn and
Uranus; ultraconservative treatment impedes progress.
In this square, Saturn chastens Uranian waywardness.
The tension and frustration produced by this aspect
can cause accidental injury or illness. Reinforced by
other afflictions, the aspect may attract violence.
Saturn Square Neptune: This square generates fear,
anxiety and insecurity. Saturn forces the individual to
face reality; Neptune deceives and confuses. Attempts
to evade difficulties associated with the affairs
governed by Saturn and Neptune create greater
problems. Frequently, these people fail to recognize
the true nature of the problems they encounter;
consequently, remedial action is ineffective. Many of
these people are lonely; some turn to drugs or alcohol
for solace: others become recluses. This square warns
against devious practices, for deceit can bring about
one's downfall.
Saturn Square Pluto: This aspect sometimes restrains the
higher evolutionary principles of Pluto. Affairs ruled by
Saturn and Pluto are often plagued with calamities,
disasters and other misfortunes that retard progress. This
aspect encourages greed and avarice; it is associated with
brutal power plays and criminal activity.
Saturn Square North Node Square South Node: These
aspects promote prejudices that inhibit development
in areas influenced by Saturn and the Nodes. These
people tend to cling to selfish attitudes described by
the South Node.
Saturn Square Part of Fortune: This square produces
barriers to benefits associated with the Part of Fortune.
Misfortune rather than success is indicated.
Saturn Square Ascendant Square Descendant: This
aspect combination fosters negative attitudes. Remote
and cynical, these people are distant with marriage
partners and mistrustful of business partners.
Saturn Square MC Square IC: This combination of
aspects describes reversals that hinder one's career. Rigid
parental discipline in childhood and heavy family
responsibilities in adult life are also indicated.
Saturn Trines
A Saturn trine enables one to structure the affairs
governed by Satum and the trined planet around realistic
goals. Satum trines are associated with practical
developments and concrete rewards. Satum, in itself,
does not signify abstract benefits. If spiritual benefits are
promised by the planet, signs or houses involved in a
Satum trine, substantive results are produced in addition
to any abstract blessings that manifest.
Satum Trine Uranus: Under the influence of this aspect
traditional concepts can be expanded and adapted to
modern modes of life. These people utilize
contemporary practices in developing the affairs ruled
by Satum and Uranus without destroying the essence
of associated traditions. This trine gives practical
expression to inventive abilities. It brings scientific
research into the realm of applied technology. This
aspect also provides constructive avenues tor
humanitarian expression.

They support self-help movements such as those that

Satum Trine Ascendant Sextile Descendant: This

Saturn Oppositions
Planets that oppose Satum defy tradition, discipline,
conservatism and other Satum qualities. Satum
oppositions reveal conflicting attitudes that affect the
houses ruled and occupied by Satum and the opposing
planets. It is up to the individual to balance these
conflicts and to utilize positive traits of Satum and
the planets in opposition.
Satum Opposite Uranus: This opposition pits
conservatism against radicalism, discipline against
independence. These people tolerate no interference
in the activities governed by Satum and Uranus. They
demand complete freedom of action in these matters;
yet, their behavior toward others concerned is
repressive and dictatorial. The interests influenced by
this aspect develop erratically and are subject to
sudden breaks, unexpected reversals and misfortunes
caused by external crises.
Satum Opposite Neptune: This aspect seriously
undermines one's sense of reality. Constructive action
in areas governed by the opposing planets is weakened
by inefficiency, unreliability and lack of organized
endeavor. These affairs may be breeding grounds for
treachery and scandal. Some of these people are
untrustworthy. These people seldom openly confront
the conflicts produced by this opposition; instead, they
employ subterfuge to get around problems. This aspect
generates mistrust, suspicion and remorse.
Satum Opposite Pluto: This opposition indicates that
diligence and discipline can open the door to Plutonian
evolution. The outcome of affairs influenced by this
aspect depends upon the individual's capacity for hard
work and disciplined effort. Action can be constructive
or destructive. This aspect fosters cupidity and ruthless
ambition. If criminal tendencies are strong in the
horoscope, this aspect can motivate lawless activity.
Satum Opposite North Node Conjunct South Node:
This combination of aspects restricts the capacity to
develop adequately in areas influenced by either Node.
These people are afraid to reach out to new experiences
described by the North Node; they find security in
tradition. The South Node points to rigid prejudices
and selfish practices, which inhibit growth.
Satum Opposite Part of Fortune: This opposition
alerts one to the need for disciplined action and
controlled endeavor if areas influenced by the Part of
Fortune are to develop successfully. Heavy afflictions
to Satum or the Part of Fortune increase the severity
of handicaps that restrain development in affairs
affected by the opposition.

Saturn Parallels
Saturn parallels imply responsible action and
constructive effort in affairs governed by Saturn and
planets in parallel. A parallel that occurs between
Saturn and a planet in zodiacal aspect with Saturn
reinforces the aspect and is interpreted accordingly.
Other Saturn parallels compare with Saturn
conjunctions, but parallel influence is milder. If Satum
or the planet in parallel is heavily afflicted, the parallel
assumes negative characteristics of the corresponding
conjunction. Parallels formed between Saturn and
Uranus, Neptune or Pluto have little personal
significance; the influence of these aspects is general
unless other factors support narrower interpretation.
Satum Contraparallels
Satum contraparallels describe hardship and misfortunes
that afflict affairs ruled by Satum and the aspected
planet(s). These aspects are restrictive and oppressive.
A contraparallel that occurs between Satum and the
Ascendant or MC is treated as an afflicted conjunction.
Other Saturn contraparallels are interpreted as mild
oppositions; however, contraparallels do not produce
the awareness associated with oppositions. Contra-
parallels that occur between Satum and Uranus,
Neptune or Pluto are interpreted broadly unless other
factors indicate personal significance.
Minor Satum Aspects
Minor Easy Aspects Formed by Saturn: Minor easy
aspects that Saturn forms are of secondary impor-
tance. These aspects channel planetary energies into
the houses and affairs influenced by Satum and the
aspected planets. Although these aspects provide for
constructive utilization of planetary energies, resultant
achievements are less significant than those produced
by the major aspects. Minor easy aspects that occur
between Saturn and Uranus, Neptune or Pluto carry
little weight in a natal horoscope.
Minor Hard Aspects Formed by Satum: Minor hard
aspects formed by Saturn describe frustrations and
aggravations that impede developments in affairs
governed by Saturn and the aspected planets. These
aspects do not create severe hardships; they produce
friction and stress and give rise to situations that
hamper progress. Minor hard aspects that Saturn
forms with Uranus, Neptune or Pluto exert little
influence in a natal horoscope.

Uranus Aspects
Uranian aspects produce changes in areas influenced by
Uranus and the aspected planets. Favorable Uranian
aspects bring about progressive changes that facilitate
the advancement of affairs. Adverse Uranian aspects
encourage radical action: these aspects foster irretriev-
able breaks, sudden catastrophes and major crises.
Aspects that occur between Uranus and Neptune or
Pluto have little personal impact unless one of the
planets in aspect occupies the first house, rules the
horoscope or disposits the horoscope ruler, the Sun
or the Moon. The main emphasis of these aspects is
directed toward the houses the aspecting planets
occupy and the houses these planets rule (according
to the signs on the cusps). The signs these heavy
planets occupy and the houses they naturally rule
represent common factors that influence many people
whose horoscopes contain the same aspect.
Due to the eccentric orbits of Uranus and Pluto and
the lengthy retrograde periods of the three outer
planets, the same Uranus/Neptune or Uranus/Pluto
aspect may reform during two or more consecutive
years. Partile years are given for each aspect: however,
its influence, active while the aspect is in allowable
orb, extends over a much longer period of time.
Uranus Conjunctions
Uranus brings originality and progress to the planets
it conjuncts and to the affairs governed by these
planets. Uranus conjunctions merge humanitarian
drives with the energies of the aspected planets. When
unafflicted they produce free and uninhibited
planetary expression. Afflicted Uranus conjunctions
generate resistance, rebellion and revolt.
Uranus Conjunct Neptune (1820, 1993): This aspect,
which last occurred in 1820, recurs about every one
hundred seventy-one years. This conjunction has a
generational effect on psychic and spiritual development.
If Uranus or Neptune bears personal influence in the
individual horoscope, interest is created in spiritualism,
mediumship, astrology, science and related fields. It also
encourages scientific research. These people are
imaginative and innovative, and employ experimental
methods in the affairs activated by the conjunction.
Many devise ingenious gadgets and labor-saving devices.
If the conjunction is afflicted, inventive ideas are
impractical; matters controlled by Uranus and Neptune
suffer from internal confusion and external misfortunes.
Some of these people follow false prophets or support
unworthy humanitarian causes.
Uranus Conjunct Pluto (1965/66): This conjunction
takes place about every one hundred fifteen years. It
is the major force behind revolutionary developments
that alter the modes of life of the generation it affects.
An era of progressive reform is signaled. If Uranus or
Pluto has personal significance in the horoscope
change, innovation and reform are major factors in
the development of affairs influenced by the
conjunction. These people show deep interest in the
occult; many are talented occultists. If the conjunction
is afflicted, magical powers are often diverted toward
base and selfish purposes. Sexual deviations are
possible if confirming factors exist in the horoscope.
Uranus Conjunct North Node Opposite South Node:
This aspect combination shows an affinity for modern
trends. These people keep in step with the times. They
are neither intimidated by changing conditions nor

Uranus Conjunct Part of Fortune: This conjunction

Uranus and the Part of Fortune. However, unless the

premature endeavors, ill-conceived changes and erratic

Uranus Conjunct Ascendant Opposite Descendant:

Uranus Sextiles
Uranus sextiles present unusual opportunities, which
arise unexpectedly. The individual who is unprepared
cannot fully utilize these opportunities, for they appear
suddenly and are withdrawn abruptly. The individual

Uranus squares provoke rebellion, sudden disasters and

misfortunes, abrupt changes and eccentric treatment.
Uranus Square Neptune (1954/55): This square is
associated with major disasters such as those caused

flash floods, airplane crashes and ship sinkings.
Nations may be misled by false social doctrines and

of this aspect. On a personal level, this aspect creates
peculiar conditions, chaos and panic in affairs ruled
by Uranus and Neptune. Development of related
interests is often interruped by tragic circumstances
over which the individual has no control. These
interests may fail to progress properly because the
individual is unable to cope with the confusion and
instability that the square generates.
Uranus Square Pluto (1932-34): This aspect indicates

thought to foster political upheaval, anarchy and
revolt. If it has personal significance in the horoscope,

causes or become involved in terrorist activities.
Sexual abuse is possible if other factors in the

Uranus Oppositions
Uranus oppositions are especially difficult to handle.
The opposition is basically a separative aspect; Uranus
is disruptive by nature and fosters breaks. Affairs
governed by Uranus and a planet in opposition can
be so shattered by misfortune and disaster that few
pieces remain with which to rebuild. Uranus forces
change and does not mend the breaches it provokes.
After a Uranian break, the individual is presented with
an entirely different set of circumstances than existed
before, and there is no way to completely restore
former conditions. Conditions may be improved or
not depending upon how the individual deals with
Uranian experiences.
UranusOpposite Neptune (1906-1910): This aspect has

hurricanes, typhoons and tidal waves of the sort that

planets often catch the individual completely off guard.

disaster. This aspect also attracts disturbing, negative
psychic experiences that can be dangerous.

Uranus Parallels
Parallels that Uranus forms with the inner planets are
interpreted as weak conjunctions. The emphasis of these
Uranus parallels depends upon aspects that other planets
form with Uranus and the paralleled planets. Influence
extends to the signs and houses ruled and occupied by
Uranus and planets in parallel and the affairs governed
by planets that aspect the paralleled planets.
Parallels that occur between Uranus and the other
outer planets are insignificant in the natal horoscope
unless Uranus or the paralleled planet is strong in the
horoscope. These parallels, if personally significant,
indicate erratic conditions and changing situations in
accordance with the nature of the paralleled planets.
Unpredictable circumstances affect the stability of affairs
governed by Uranus and outer planets in parallel with
Uranus. If afflicted, these parallels do not exert the
destructive impact associated with some afflicted
Uranian conjunctions; they do not imply sexual
aberrations. Under affliction, these parallels strengthen
adversities indicated by the afflicting planets.
A parallel that occurs between Uranus and the
North Node, Part of Fortune, Ascendant or MC acts
as a mild conjunction.
Uranus Contraparallels
Contraparallels that are formed between Uranus and the
inner planets, the North Node and the Part of Fortune
assume the nature of corresponding oppositions, but
they carry much less impact than oppositions.
Contraparallels that Uranus forms with other outer
planets are interpreted as mild oppositions. These
aspects have general application to the generation bom
during the time the aspects remain in orb. They do
not connote the major disasters, extreme violence or
sexual deviations that are associated with some
Uranian oppositions.
A contraparallel that occurs between Uranus and
the Ascendant or MC bears the influence of an afflicted
conjunction. A Uranus/Ascendant contraparallel in-
fluences the personality and first house affairs. These
people are magnetic, individualistic, extremist, radical,
unpredictable, rebellious and eccentric. Personal
interests are unstable. Things suddenly go awry for
these people. A Uranus/MC contraparallel adversely
affects one's career and other tenth house interests. It
is indicative of sudden career or business reversals and
frequent job changes.

generate serious rifts or drastic changes. The influence
of minor hard aspects that occur between Uranus and
other outer planets is negligible in a natal horoscope.

Neptune Aspects
Neptune aspects bring intangible forces into play. They
influence imagination, inspiration, intuition, psychic
receptivity and spiritual development. Favorable
Neptune aspects foster sympathy, sensitivity,
psychism and spiritual idealism. They support artistic
ability and produce imagery and creative inspiration.
Adverse Neptune aspects induce illusions, delusions,
hallucinations, obscurities and fallacies. An afflicted
Neptune beguiles and bewilders and thus creates
confusion and chaos in the affairs governed by
Neptune and the afflicting planet(s). Neptune
afflictions generate superstition, escapism, hypocrisy,
treachery and deceit. The influence of a Neptune
conjunction depends upon the nature of aspects made
to the conjunction.
The aspects Neptune forms with other outer planets
do not occur often; when they do form, they remain
in orb for lengthy time periods. These aspects have a
generational effect and do not exert much influence on
a particular individual unless Neptune or the aspected
planet bears personal significance in the horoscope.

misleads and obscures. The individual may be

Pluto Aspects
Pluto aspects bring about transformation for better
or worse. This process is a gradual one that develops
slowly throughout the individual's lifetime. Favorable
Pluto aspects induce spiritual, mental, emotional,
physical or material regeneration in accordance with
the planets, signs and houses involved. Adverse Pluto
aspects are associated with degeneration. The emphasis
of a Pluto conjunction depends upon the nature of
aspects made to the conjunction. A favorably aspected
Pluto conjunction elevates Plutonian qualities; an
afflicted conjunction emphasizes base characteristics
of Pluto.
In interpreting Pluto aspects, Pluto's strength in the
horoscope and its influence on the individual must be
carefully considered. Many people do not seem to
react individually to the influence of this planet unless
Pluto rules the Ascendant, rules a sign (Scorpio)
intercepted within the first house, occupies the first
house, or disposits or forms major aspects with the
chart ruler, planets co-ruling or occupying the first
house, the Sun or the Moon.
Aspects that Pluto forms with outer planets are
indicative of mass movements and worldwide trends
that are part of the history of the generation the Pluto
aspect influences. These aspects may affect the
individual on a personal level, but if so, Pluto must
exert strong personal influence in the natal horoscope.
Because Pluto is the slowest moving planet, it cannot
act as significator in any aspect it forms with another
planet unless the motion of the planet in aspect is slow
of course or stationary. The interpretations for aspects
that occur between Pluto and other planets are listed
under the aspects of the planet that normally acts as
significator as all planetary aspects are listed except
those formed by the Sun.

of life. If Pluto is afflicted, experiences associated with
interests Pluto governs can have a degrading effect.

Fortune. The affairs influenced by this aspect bring

is placed at the disposal of the individual. The potential
for regeneration or degeneration clearly rests with the
individual. In this configuration, Pluto strengthens
personal qualities described by the Ascendant and first
house. Physical stamina and recuperative powers are
increased. If Pluto is afflicted, the individual tends to
promote self-interests ruthlessly. The personal safety of
the individual is threatened

chieftan who controls a large segment of the criminal
element; or they may be found in the horoscope of a
tribal medicine man who exerts more influence in the
daily lives of the tribe members" than does the chief. The
emphasis of these aspects is not so much on renown or
public dishonor, although either is possible, as it is on
the massive influence these people wield. Many of these
people choose to remain anonymous to the public in
order to protect the power they achieve.

associated with Pluto and the Part of Fortune. If the

affairs and overcome family drawbacks.

Other Pluto Aspects
Pluto Parallels: Parallels that Pluto forms with the

Minor Pluto Aspects: Minor aspects that occur

angles are of no significance in the natal horoscope.
These aspects are not usually calculated or listed in
the aspectarian.
